dict.string: DailyVox uses Face ID to lock and unlock access to your private diary entries.

DailyVox reads sleep, heart, steps and mindfulness data on this iPhone so your Twin can understand what your body felt around each entry. You review every signal before your Twin learns it; nothing is uploaded or synced.
DailyVox never writes or changes anything in Apple Health. The app only reads sleep, heart, steps and mindfulness data on this iPhone; no update access is requested or used.
DailyVox needs microphone access to record your voice diary entries.
DailyVox uses motion activity to tell whether you were moving when a journal entry was made, so body signals are read in the right context. Activity context stays on this iPhone.

With your permission, DailyVox reads your recent music listening on this iPhone to derive a one-line mood note (like "reached for calm music") for your Twin. You review every note before it is kept; only the derived label is produced, and nothing about your music leaves this device.

DailyVox lets you attach photos to your diary entries, and — only if you turn on Photo context — reads the day's photos on this iPhone to derive a one-line scene note (like "mostly trail photos") for your Twin. You review every note before it is kept. Photos are analyzed on-device and never leave your iPhone.
DailyVox uses speech recognition to transcribe your voice recordings into text.
